content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE METEO_MODULE (banner says 'FILE mod_storm.F' L3; header L46-47: wind and pressure effects, sources for meteo tsunami and landslide; entire file under # if defined (METEO), L54/L1198). Four forcing mechanisms selected by input.txt logicals (declared L68-74): WindConstantField, WindHollandModel, MeteoGausian, SlideModel, plus WindForce/AirPressure/WindWaveInteraction. Module data: WIND_FILE, NumTimeWindData, WindU2D/WindV2D, TimeWind/WU/WV series, Cdw, WindCrestPercent, icount_winddata=1, MASK_WIND (L75-82); storm track states 1/2 (Xstorm1/2, Ystorm1/2, Pn/Pc/A/B_storm1/2, TimeStorm1/2, ThetaStorm L84-87); Gaussian parameters DP_storm1/2, SigmaX/Y1/2, Theta1/2 (L90-91); StormPressureTotal/X/Y and local coordinates Xco/Yco (L93-95); OUT_METEO=.TRUE. (L96); slide parameters LengthSlide/WidthSlide/AlphaSlide/BetaSlide/PSlide/epsilon and FirstCall_Met=.TRUE. (L99-100). METEO_INITIAL (L111-350): allocates and zeroes pressure and wind arrays (L122-132), reads the four model selectors via READ_LOGICAL (L148, L163, L178, L193); MeteoGausian forces AirPressure=.TRUE. (L208-210); for Holland/constant wind reads WindWaveInteraction (L215), AirPressure (L231), WindForce (L247, forced .TRUE. when WindConstantField L250-251), Cdw with default 0.002_SP (L278-280), WindCrestPercent default LARGE and reset to LARGE unless WindWaveInteraction (L292-308); dispatches to Holland_Model_Setup (L327), MeteoGausian_Setup (L333), Contant_Wind_Field_Setup (L340), Slide_Model_Setup (L345); reads OUT_METEO (L348). METEO_FORCING (L352-380) dispatches per step to Holland_Model_Forcing (L360), MeteoGausian_Forcing (L366), Constant_Wind_Forcing (L372), Slide_Model_Forcing (L377). Holland_Model_Setup (L382-494): reads STORM_FILE name (L399), builds local coordinates Xco/Yco from (iista-1)*DX / (jjsta-1)*DY under PARALLEL else ZERO, extended into ghosts (L407-441), opens unit 300 (L461-462) and reads title/name/header plus first track record TimeStorm2,Xstorm2,Ystorm2,Pn_storm2,Pc_storm2,A_storm2,B_storm2 (L465-469), copying state 2 to state 1 (L471-477). Contant_Wind_Field_Setup (L496-536): reads CONSTANT_WIND_FILE (L510), opens unit 2, reads NumTimeWindData then (TimeWind,WU,WV) series (L525-534). Holland_Model_Forcing (L538-670): when TIME passes both track times, shifts state and reads the next record from unit 300 (L549-558) and updates ThetaStorm=ATAN2 (L574-575); linear time interpolation weights tmp2=(TimeStorm2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,|T2-T1|), tmp1=1-tmp2 (L584-594) to interpolate Xstorm/Ystorm/Pn/Pc/A/B (L596-601); over all cells computes Rdis in km (L609-610), Holland pressure profile Pw=Pc+(Pn-Pc)*EXP(-A/Rdis**B) in mb (L612), stored as head Pw/100 when AirPressure (L615, comment says 'convert from cm to meter'), gradient wind speed Vw=SQRT(A*B*100*|Pn-Pc|*EXP(-A/Rdis**B)/Rho_air/Rdis**B) (L618-619), wind direction from AngleLocal=ATAN2(dx,dy) (L621) giving cyclonic WindU2D=-Vw*COS, WindV2D=Vw*SIN, minus wave celerity components (Celerity=MIN(|ETAt|/|grad ETA|, sqrt(g|H|)), WaveAngle) when WindWaveInteraction (L623-635); MASK_WIND=0 where ETA below crest fraction ETA<HeightMax*(1-WindCrestPercent)+ETAmean (L643-654); pressure-gradient forcing StormPressureX/Y=-Grav*H*central difference/2/DX,DY (L656-667). Constant_Wind_Forcing (L672-729): steps icount_winddata through TimeWind (L682-685), interpolates uniform WindU2D/WindV2D from WU/WV (L686-697), optional celerity adjustment 'based on Chen et al. 2004' (L699-714), same MASK_WIND crest logic (L716-725). Slide_Model_Setup (L731-845): sets epsilon=0.717, AirPressure=.TRUE., WindForce=.FALSE. (L744-746), reads SLIDE_FILE (L752), Xco/Yco (L759-791), opens unit 300, reads slide geometry LengthSlide,WidthSlide,AlphaSlide,BetaSlide,PSlide and first track point (L811-825). Slide_Model_Forcing (L847-946): same track advance/interpolation for TimeStorm/X/Y (L857-899); pressure shape C=acosh(1/epsilon), Kb=2C/Width, Kw=2C/Length (L905-907), StormPressureTotal=(Pslide/(1-epsilon))*(sech(Kw*(x-xs))*sech(Kb*(y-ys))-epsilon) clipped at 0 (L909-921); on first call initializes Eta=Eta0=-StormPressureTotal (L923-933); same -Grav*H*grad forcing (L935-944). MeteoGausian_Setup (L948-1059): reads METEO_GAUSIAN_FILE (L965), Xco/Yco, opens unit 300 and reads TimeStorm2,Xstorm2,Ystorm2,DP_storm2,SigmaX2,SigmaY2,Theta2 (L1030-1042). MeteoGausian_Forcing (L1061-1193): track advance and interpolation of dP_storm/SigmaX/SigmaY/Theta (deg->rad, L1115-1120); under LINEAR_JUMP a half-plane pressure jump dP_Storm*0.01 by angle test (L1124-1139); otherwise rotated anisotropic Gaussian with a,b,c coefficients (L1159-1164) and StormPressureTotal=dP_Storm*EXP(-(a*dx^2+2b*dx*dy+c*dy^2))/100 (L1169-1171), STOP if SigmaX or SigmaY is zero (L1144-1157); same gradient forcing (L1182-1191).

verbatim_spans.text: !  METEO is a module to model wind and pressure effects
StormPressureTotal(I,J) = Pw/100.0_SP  ! convert from cm to meter
120 CONTINUE  ! no more data for vessel Kves
! adjusted by wave celerity based on Chen et al. 2004

unresolved: Unit comments are internally inconsistent: Pw is in mb (comment L611) but the AirPressure conversion comment says 'convert from cm to meter' with /100 (L615); the Gaussian branch divides by 100 (L1171) and the LINEAR_JUMP branch multiplies by 0.01 (L1134) with the same 'cm to meter' comment. Whether dP inputs are cm of water or mb is not determinable from this file.

tmp3 is assigned in Holland_Model_Forcing (L625) and Constant_Wind_Forcing (L705) but is not in either subroutine's USE GLOBAL,ONLY list (L539, L673) nor the module-level list (L58-59); its resolution (likely USE PARAM at L57) is external. In both places tmp3 is computed but never used afterwards.
Comment '120 CONTINUE ! no more data for vessel Kves' (L603, L901, L1122) is a copy-paste from a vessel module; there is no Kves here.

Cross-line: AngleLocal=ATAN2((Xco-Xstorm),(Yco-Ystorm)) (L621) has the x-difference as the first (y) argument - the wind direction convention (angle measured from north) and the -COS/+SIN composition (L630-634) yield a cyclonic rotation whose hemisphere/sign convention is not documented in this file.
AlphaSlide and BetaSlide are read (L818-819) but never used in Slide_Model_Forcing (L847-946); slide speed/acceleration comes solely from the track file positions.

Slide_Model_Forcing initializes Eta and Eta0 to -StormPressureTotal on first call (L924-925) - a static-response initial condition; Eta/Eta0 are module-imported globals (L59) written from inside METEO.

Xco/Yco are allocated in each Setup routine (L407, L759, L973); if two mechanisms were enabled simultaneously the second ALLOCATE of an already-allocated array would fail - mutual exclusion is not enforced in code.
Holland setup validates nothing about record monotonicity in time; ThetaStorm (L574, L877) is computed but never used in this file.
WHAT is read from the constant wind file header (L526) and discarded; StationName/StormName strings are used only for logging.
MASK_WIND is computed (L644-654, L716-725) but not used within this module - its consumer is external.
In non-PARALLEL Gaussian zero-sigma failure, STOP occurs (L1155) but the setup-time check is absent - a zero sigma in the first record fails only at first forcing call.
